```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
DATASET <- "QDS"
PathDataset <- file.path(root, "data", "datasets", sprintf("%s.csv", DATASET))
PathSources <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv")
PathScenarios <- file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv")
if (any(!file.exists(c(PathDataset, PathSources, PathScenarios)))) {
  stop("model.domain.compare: required model products are missing.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

AUX <- data.table::fread(
  PathDataset,
  select = c("set", "D", "MIC", "SD")
)[set == "train"]
if (!nrow(AUX) ||
    AUX[, any(!is.finite(D) | D <= 0 | !is.finite(MIC) | MIC <= 0 |
              !is.finite(SD) | SD <= 0)]) {
  stop("model.domain.compare: invalid model-fitting observations.", call. = FALSE)
}
N.OBS <- nrow(AUX)
RANGE.D <- range(AUX$D)
RANGE.Q <- range(AUX$MIC)
RANGE.SD <- range(AUX$SD)

AUX <- unique(data.table::fread(
  PathScenarios,
  select = c("D", "MIC", "P")
))
if (!nrow(AUX) || AUX[, uniqueN(P)] != 1L) {
  stop("model.domain.compare: invalid scenario conditions.", call. = FALSE)
}
N.GRID <- nrow(AUX)
P.GRID <- unique(AUX$P)

GRID_LABEL <- "Scenario conditions"
GROUP_LEGEND <- "Set"
SOURCE_COLORS <- setNames(
  c("#00838f", "rgba(110,110,110,0.28)", "#d95f02"),
  c("IMPALA", "S11D", GRID_LABEL)
)
CAP.QD <- sprintf(
  paste(
    "Observations included in model fitting in the physical $Q$--$D$ domain",
    "($n=%s$; $D=%s$ m; $Q=%s$ kg), distinguished by source, and %s",
    "scenario conditions evaluated at $p=%s$. $Q$ denotes maximum",
    "instantaneous charge (MIC). Scenario markers are demand conditions,",
    "not observations or selected records; both axes are logarithmic."
  ),
  format(N.OBS, big.mark = ","),
  paste(formatC(round(RANGE.D), format = "d", big.mark = ","), collapse = "--"),
  paste(formatC(round(RANGE.Q), format = "d", big.mark = ","), collapse = "--"),
  N.GRID,
  formatC(P.GRID, format = "f", digits = 2L)
)
CAP.QSD <- sprintf(
  paste(
    "Observations included in model fitting in the transformed $Q$--$SD$ domain",
    "($n=%s$; $SD=%s$ m/kg$^{0.5}$; $Q=%s$ kg), distinguished by source,",
    "and %s scenario conditions evaluated at $p=%s$. $Q$ denotes maximum",
    "instantaneous charge (MIC), and $SD=D/\\sqrt{Q}$. Scenario markers are",
    "demand conditions, not observations or selected records; both axes are",
    "logarithmic."
  ),
  format(N.OBS, big.mark = ","),
  paste(formatC(RANGE.SD, format = "f", digits = 2L), collapse = "--"),
  paste(formatC(round(RANGE.Q), format = "d", big.mark = ","), collapse = "--"),
  N.GRID,
  formatC(P.GRID, format = "f", digits = 2L)
)
rm(AUX)
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

### Physical domain ($Q$--$D$)

```{r}
#| label: fig-model-domain-qd
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.QD
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
X_AXIS <- "D [m]"
Y_AXIS <- "Q (MIC) [kg]"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "model.domain.R"))
PLOT
```

### Transformed domain ($Q$--$SD$)

```{r}
#| label: fig-model-domain-qsd
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.QSD
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
X_AXIS <- "SD [m/kg^0.5]"
Y_AXIS <- "Q (MIC) [kg]"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "model.domain.SD.R"))
PLOT
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(
  CAP.QD, CAP.QSD, DATASET, GRID_LABEL, GROUP_LEGEND, N.GRID, N.OBS,
  P.GRID, PLOT, PathDataset, PathScenarios, PathSources, RANGE.D, RANGE.Q,
  RANGE.SD, SOURCE_COLORS, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS
)
```
